sentences.en: I can't listen to music at night anymore because my headphones broke.
sentences.zh: 因为我的耳机坏了，我晚上不能再听音乐了。

sentences.en: When I'm using headphones I can't hear anything.
sentences.zh: 戴上耳机后我就什么都听不见了。

sentences.en: The girl wearing headphones seemed to be asleep.
sentences.zh: 戴着耳机的女孩好像睡着了。

senses.zh: [电讯] 耳机；听筒；[电子] 头戴式受话器（headphone的复数形式）
